# Punt FG%: Player Targets

**Summary.** In our 12-team 9-cat league, punting FG% lets you buy high-volume guards and wings whose main cost is a low FG%. You pay for points, threes and assists, and you protect FT%. The best values are LaMelo Ball, Bam Adebayo, James Harden and Brandon Miller at fair prices, Derrick White and Damian Lillard below their expert value, and a group of 1 to 5 USD late picks to fill the bench spots.

## Why FG% swings week to week

FG% is the noisiest category from game to game and from week to week. FT% varies more from one season to the next, but within a season FG% moves the most. In a head-to-head week you only need to beat one opponent, so a cold shooting week can lose you FG% even with a good roster. ([10-01](https://youtu.be/aLP080hxizA?t=2135), [09-23](https://youtu.be/C4vlgpJ62NI?t=1472))

Low-volume weeks make it worse. With fewer attempts, each miss moves the ratio more. Our lineups are daily, so a light schedule week cuts your total attempts and makes FG% close to a coin flip. ([10-01](https://youtu.be/aLP080hxizA?t=2135))

Do not pay extra for a high FG% either. Players with outlier FG% tend to regress, and a small drop can wipe out most of their edge. Good efficiency on low volume also does little for a team ratio. ([07-07](https://youtu.be/ME-r173X5b0?t=2107), [09-10](https://youtu.be/W-R1dzem32s?t=1120))

## Why punting one percentage works in H2H

Being strong in both FG% and FT% is very hard. If you barely win both, the win is fragile, and the money you spent on it leaves you short in other categories. Punting one of them frees that money. ([07-15](https://youtu.be/0geFVzSqOnA?t=1264))

Because FG% is so variable, it is the cheaper one to give up. You still win it some weeks by luck. You then compete in the other 8 categories and need 5 of them to win the week. One expert prefers steady volume over a small efficiency edge, and that is what this build buys. ([09-23](https://youtu.be/C4vlgpJ62NI?t=1472), [09-16](https://youtu.be/2A2JbUN-kc0?t=1744))

Keep FT% alive. Many targets below shoot well from the line: Harden has strong FT%, Miller is about 88%, VanVleet is 84.7%, and Lillard and Grayson Allen are named as FT% sources. Pair them so that FT% becomes a category you win. ([07-15](https://youtu.be/0geFVzSqOnA?t=1264), [James Harden](../profiles/players/james-harden.md), [Brandon Miller](../profiles/players/brandon-miller.md), [Fred VanVleet](../profiles/players/fred-vanvleet.md), [Damian Lillard](../profiles/players/damian-lillard.md), [Grayson Allen](../profiles/players/grayson-allen.md))

Many of these players also turn the ball over a lot. Ball (3.2 TO), Trae Young (4.2), Miller (2.7), Harden and Jalen Green are listed as punt TO fits too. If you roster several, decide by the middle of the draft whether you are also punting TO. If not, cap the number of high-turnover guards. ([LaMelo Ball](../profiles/players/lamelo-ball.md), [Trae Young](../profiles/players/trae-young.md), [Brandon Miller](../profiles/players/brandon-miller.md), [James Harden](../profiles/players/james-harden.md), [Jalen Green](../profiles/players/jalen-green.md))

## Core targets and price discipline

LaMelo Ball is the top target. He gives elite threes and assists, and his costs are about 41% FG on 19 to 20 attempts plus turnovers. Anything near 30 USD is fair. Check that he plays 30 to 32 minutes next to Edwards. His two-game week starting March 15 falls in our playoffs. ([LaMelo Ball](../profiles/players/lamelo-ball.md))

Bam Adebayo gives a big's rebounds plus points, steals and threes, with about 44.6% FG on 16 attempts. Bid up to about 27 USD, not ESPN's 43 USD value. Check the groin status before the draft. Miami gets only 10 playoff games. ([Bam Adebayo](../profiles/players/bam-adebayo.md))

James Harden brings elite assists, strong FT% and threes at about 42% FG. Bid in the low to mid 20s, not round-two money. Brandon Miller gives elite threes for a forward, points and about 88% FT on 17 to 18 shots at about 43%. About 20 to 26 USD fits. Harden has a two-game finals week. Miller's shoulder needs watching. ([James Harden](../profiles/players/james-harden.md), [Brandon Miller](../profiles/players/brandon-miller.md))

## Where the markets and experts disagree

Trae Young splits the sources. Yahoo values him at 38 USD and our league paid 44 USD last season. ESPN values him at 11 USD, and the experts call him a bust at rank 18. His 10.4 projected assists fit this build, but pay only a price that fits around pick 26. ([Trae Young](../profiles/players/trae-young.md))

Damian Lillard and Derrick White go the other way. The markets price Lillard very low, while the newest expert calls put him in the top 50 with top 30 upside, so 10 to 17 USD is a strong buy. White gives threes, assists and guard blocks and plays nearly every game. Experts value him in the mid 20s, so stay below last season's 30 USD. ([Damian Lillard](../profiles/players/damian-lillard.md), [Derrick White](../profiles/players/derrick-white.md))

## Late picks and early-season checks

Only 144 players get drafted, so the last rounds still matter. Fred VanVleet, Myles Turner, Jabari Smith Jr., Jalen Green and Egor Dëmin are 1 to 5 USD picks. Each one gives volume at a FG% cost: threes and assists from VanVleet, Green and Dëmin, and blocks and threes from Turner and Smith. ([Fred VanVleet](../profiles/players/fred-vanvleet.md), [Myles Turner](../profiles/players/myles-turner.md), [Jabari Smith Jr.](../profiles/players/jabari-smith.md), [Jalen Green](../profiles/players/jalen-green.md), [Egor Dëmin](../profiles/players/egor-demin.md))

Check the playoff schedules. Houston (VanVleet, Smith) and Portland (Lillard) have weak 10-game playoff schedules, so Lillard is a possible sell before the March 4 deadline. Phoenix (Green) and Memphis (Grant) have 4-4-4 schedules. ([Fred VanVleet](../profiles/players/fred-vanvleet.md), [Jabari Smith Jr.](../profiles/players/jabari-smith.md), [Damian Lillard](../profiles/players/damian-lillard.md), [Jalen Green](../profiles/players/jalen-green.md), [Jerami Grant](../profiles/players/jerami-grant.md))

Grayson Allen and Herbert Jones are 1 USD final picks at most. Jerami Grant and De'Anthony Melton belong on the waiver watch list. In the first weeks, check who starts and plays about 28 to 30 minutes, and use FAB on the ones who win a role. ([Grayson Allen](../profiles/players/grayson-allen.md), [Herbert Jones](../profiles/players/herbert-jones.md), [Jerami Grant](../profiles/players/jerami-grant.md), [De'Anthony Melton](../profiles/players/deanthony-melton.md))
